title: Our Home
text:
My name is Ali. I live with my family in a big house in Ankara. We have a red kitchen and a green garden. My mother cooks dinner every night.

My father reads books in the living room. My little brother plays with his ball in the garden. On Saturdays, we all clean the house together. I like helping my mother.

questions.text: Where does the father read books?
How does Ali probably feel about helping at home?
What kind of family is Ali's family?
options: A family that is always alone
A family that never eats at home

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who are related to each other
a piece of land next to a house where plants and flowers grow
with each other, in the same place
the room in a house where food is cooked

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Ailemle Ankara'da büyük bir evde yaşıyorum. Kırmızı bir mutfağımız ve yeşil bir bahçemiz var. Annem her gece akşam yemeği pişirir.
Babam oturma odasında kitap okur. Küçük kardeşim bahçede topuyla oynar. Cumartesi günleri hepimiz evi birlikte temizleriz. Anneme yardım etmeyi seviyorum.
